bloodFueled.name: Blood Fueled
bloodFueled.description: Firing Weapon has a cost of 4% hull health. You gain increased damage based on missing hull health (up to 150% at 80% missing health). All weapons equipped gain the Phantom Mending perk.

reactiveBulwark.name: Reactive Bulwark
reactiveBulwark.description: After bracing for 3s, explode and damage hostile enemies in a 250m radius for 1000% of your armor rating.

deadlyMedicine.name: Deadly Medicine
deadlyMedicine.description: Store 100% of healing done as additional damage, up to 100000. Additional damage is added to the next successful attack on an enemy target.

finishingBlow.name: Finishing Blow
finishingBlow.description: Deal 10% increased damage to enemies below 30% of their maximum health.

fervor.name: Fervor
fervor.description: Increase weapon damage by 50% for 5 seconds after Ramming or Crew Attack (Cooldown 15s).

emergencyRepair.name: Emergency Repair
emergencyRepair.description: Upon dropping below 50% maximum hull health, you are repaired for 30% maximum hull health over 3 seconds (Cooldown 75s).

fullSailAssault.name: Full Sail Assault
fullSailAssault.description: Increases weapon damage by 15% when sailing at above 12kts. (Damage buff sticks for 5 seconds if speed drops below the speed)

shieldOfContempt.name: Shield Of Contempt
shieldOfContempt.description: Increases Armor by 100 for every enemy (up to 4) within 200m.

battleMedic.name: Battle Medic
battleMedic.description: Increases weapon damage by 10% for each Repair Weapon equipped. Effect is tripled when 4 Repair Weapons are equipped.

damageControl.name: Damage Control
damageControl.description: Repair a small amount of severe damage after not taking damage for 30s.

criticalDamageControl.name: Critical Damage Control
criticalDamageControl.description: Repairs 4% of Severe Damage per second after not taking damage for 30s.

patchworkRepairs.name: Patchwork Repairs
patchworkRepairs.description: Repair a small amount of hull health after not taking damage for 30s.

slowMending.name: Slow Mending
slowMending.description: Repairs 0.6% of Hull Health per second after not taking damage for 30s.

windBarrier.name: Wind Barrier
windBarrier.description: Reduces damage taken by 10% while sailing at 15kts or above.

trueGrit.name: True Grit
trueGrit.description: Reduce damage taken by 10% when Hull Health is 30% or below.

bloodForBlood.name: Blood For Blood
bloodForBlood.description: Increase weapon damage by 10% for 30s whenever you take damage.

viciousMunitions1.name: Vicious Munitions 1
viciousMunitions1.description: Status Effects Damage +10% Status Effects Lifetime +10%

viciousMunitions2.name: Vicious Munitions 2
viciousMunitions2.description: Status Effects Damage +15% Status Effects Lifetime +15%

specializedMunitions1.name: Specialized Munitions 1
specializedMunitions1.description: Burning Damage +30% Flooding Damage +30% Piercing Damage +30% Explosive Damage +30% Electric Damage +30% Toxic Damage +30%

specializedMunitions2.name: Specialized Munitions 2
specializedMunitions2.description: Burning Damage +30% Flooding Damage +30% Piercing Damage +30% Explosive Damage +30% Electric Damage +30% Toxic Damage +30%

adrenalSurge.name: Adrenal Surge
adrenalSurge.description: Restores 10% Hull Health after a Crew Attack.

hullbreaker.name: Hullbreaker
hullbreaker.description: Increase Ramming Damage by 50% when sailing at 15kts or higher.

versatileDefenses.name: Versatile Defenses
versatileDefenses.description: Burning Resistance +2% Flooding Resistance +2% Piercing Resistance +2% Explosive Resistance +2% Electric Resistance +2% Toxic Resistance +2%

reactiveCompounds.name: Reactive Compounds
reactiveCompounds.description: Burning Damage +20% Flooding Damage +20% Piercing Damage +20% Explosive Damage +20% Electric Damage +20% Toxic Damage +20%

heavyWeaponry.name: Heavy Weaponry
heavyWeaponry.description: Mortar Damage +15% Rocket Damage +15% Springloader Damage +15%

allHandsOnDeck.name: All Hands On Deck
allHandsOnDeck.description: Bombard Damage +10% Long Gun Damage +10% Torpedo Damage +10%

impetusOrder.name: Impetus Order
impetusOrder.description: You can now gain stacks of Impetus. When at 5 stacks of Impetus, consume 5 stacks to increase Turn Speed, Acceleration and Top Speed by 5% for 30s. When another Order Perk is activated, this buff no longer consumes Impetus and is applied permanently.

batteringForce.name: Battering Force
batteringForce.description: Generate 5 stacks of Impetus (Max 10) upon Ramming or performing a Crew Attack. Generating Impetus increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 50% for 10s.

relentlessForce.name: Relentless Force
relentlessForce.description: Generate 1 stack of Impetus (Max 10) for every 8 weapon hits on enemies. Demicannons require 4 times as many hits. Generating Impetus increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 15% for 5s.

unstoppableForce.name: Unstoppable Force
unstoppableForce.description: Generate 1 stack of Impetus (Max 10) for every 110m travelled. Generating Impetus increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 3% for every knot of speed above 10 knots, for 5s.

heavyBombardment.name: Heavy Bombardment
heavyBombardment.description: Generating Impetus increases the radius of all weapon Area-of-Effects by 5m for 10s (Max 5 stacks). At max stacks, Secondary Damage for all weapons is increased by 20%.

weaknessFinder.name: Weakness Finder
weaknessFinder.description: Generating Impetus adds a 20% chance to convert any weapon shot into a weakpoint hit for 5s.

rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
rejuvenation.description: Generating Impetus restores 3% of max HP.

stormblazeOrder.name: Stormblaze Order
stormblazeOrder.description: When at 10 stacks of Impetus, the next weapon hit consumes 10 stacks and triggers an AoE burst on the target that deals 150% of your max. Hull Health as Burning & Lightning damage to all enemies within 250m. This effect can also be triggered by Ramming without it consuming Impetus.

firepowerOrder.name: Firepower Order
firepowerOrder.description: When at 10 stacks of Impetus, fire an Auxiliary weapon to consume 10 stacks and convert all weapon hits to weakpoint hits for 8s.

mendingOrder.name: Mending Order
mendingOrder.description: When at 5 stacks of Impetus, brace for 2s and release to consume 5 stacks and release an AoE heal that heals you for 30% of your max. Hull Health as well as all allies within 350m. This effect also triggers automatically when below 50% max. Hull Health or on death.

fireAndSteel.name: Fire And Steel
fireAndSteel.description: Generate 1 stack of Impetus by applying any elemental status effect on a target. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.

vitalStrike.name: Vital Strike
vitalStrike.description: Generate 1 stack of Impetus by destroying a weakpoint. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.

killingDrive.name: Killing Drive
killingDrive.description: Generate 1 stack of Impetus by destroying a target. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.

hardenedMomentum.name: Hardened Momentum
hardenedMomentum.description: While at or above 5 stacks of Impetus, increase Armor Multiplier by 5%.

adaptiveArsenal.name: Adaptive Arsenal
adaptiveArsenal.description: Increases Weapon Damage by 5% for each different weapon type equipped

enduringBrace.name: Enduring Brace
enduringBrace.description: Increase Brace Strength Recovery by 0.01% per 1000 points of Maximum Health.

volatileArsenal.name: Volatile Arsenal
volatileArsenal.description: Increases elemental damage by 5% for each Weapon element equipped. Includes Elements gained from Weapon modifications

loadedOdds.name: Loaded Odds
loadedOdds.description: Adds a chance of 10% to generate an additional stack of Impetus whenever an Impetus stack is generated.

fortifiedHull.name: Fortified Hull
fortifiedHull.description: For every 2000 points of Brace Strength, increase incoming Repair Amount by 1% (max 10%).

revitalizedFury.name: Revitalized Fury
revitalizedFury.description: Increases Weapon Damage and Repair Amount by 15% for 5s when receiving a heal of 3% of your Maximum Health or greater.

careAndCarnage.name: Care And Carnage
careAndCarnage.description: For every 10% increases of Repair per Shot, increase Weapon Damage by 5% up to a maximum of 30%.

battleTempo.name: Battle Tempo
battleTempo.description: Increases the maximum stacks of Impetus by 5.
